description:
[v.3.0.x] Transcoded hevc with wrong codec tag [hev1], breaks playback on apple devices

Since upgrading to `v.3.0.x` transcoded videos that are configured to encode as `hevc` do not playback correctly on apple devices, both in app and in safari browser. Audio plays with a black screen.

Found that codec tag is set incorrectly to `hev1` which will not playback on apple devices.

This PR from a couple of years ago remediated the very same issue: 
https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/6712

With 3.x it appears the issue has returned. I can prove that in the log outputs further below.

If I review my timeline, the last known working transcoded asset was 1 day prior to updating to 3.0.0. Every asset transcoded with 3.0.x presents failed playback of transcoded hevc assets.

Although I have reported this regression for apple devices, it is unknown if this also impacts over devi…

tests_added: media.service.spec.ts: should include hevc tag when target is hevc and using hwa

evidence: test: media.service.spec.ts: should include hevc tag when target is hevc and using hwa

notes: Bug report with symptom (hev1 tag, black screen on Apple devices). Fix changes isHvc condition in BaseConfig.getBaseOutputOptions (RC exact).

Minor leak: report points to PR #6712 that "remediated the very same issue" (the -tag:v hvc1 logic) - gives the location class but not the change. Boundary job ok (VideoConversion job; realtime path also uses getBaseOutputOptions).
Low-severity leak flagged by the auditor: kept (auditor verdict stands).
